title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Kyklaminos root is heated in old oil but the oil is explicitly the later application bearer
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED_NO_MEANING_CLAIM. The complete cached Dioscorides II.164 §3 ends with the named root heated in old oil and explicitly names the oil as what is applied. A multistep hypothetical content account must distinguish the heated plant material from the later applied carrier, and assign old to the oil rather than to the root. Adjacent root poultice, extracted juice, and poured decoction uses are retained counterexamples to one global applied-root or applied-juice bearer. This is source-specific raw supply, not a target translation, demonstrated extraction mechanism or confirmed novel route.
